product_metadata.competition: Test Series India A vs Australia A

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire after a winner is declared.
markets.rules_primary: If India A wins the India A vs Australia A men's professional Test series cricket match originally scheduled for Sep 29, 2026 at 12:00 AM EDT, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
If the match ends in a draw or tie, the market titled "Draw/Tie" will resolve Yes.
If the match is cancelled prior to scheduled commencement, or is abandoned prior to the toss (i.e. the toss does not occur) and no
official result is declared by the governing body, then all markets will resolve to a fair market price.
If the match is delayed for more than 5 days from its original scheduled start time before commencement, then all markets will resolve to a fair market price.
If the match is abandoned after the toss has occurred, markets will resolve based on the official result recorded by the governing body of the relevant competition.
